            --slide-padding: clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
            --content-gap:   clamp(0.5rem, 2vh, 1.5rem);
            --element-gap:   clamp(0.3rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);

            /* Easing */
            --ease-out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            --dur: 0.6s;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           BASE RESET
           =========================================== */
        *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        /* ===========================================
           VIEWPORT-BASE.CSS — MANDATORY (pasted in full)
           =========================================== */
        html, body { height: 100%; overflow-x: hidden; }

        html {
            scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        /* Each slide = exact viewport height */
        .slide {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            overflow: hidden;
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
        }

        /* Content container */
        .slide-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            max-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;

        .card, .container, .content-box {

        .feature-list, .bullet-list { gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 1rem); }
        .feature-list li, .bullet-list li { font-size: var(--body-size); line-height: 1.4; }

        .grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 250px), 1fr));
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);

            object-fit: contain;

        /* Short viewports */
        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);

        }
        @media (max-height: 600px) {

        @media (max-height: 500px) {

           =========================================== */

        /* ===========================================

           =========================================== */
        body {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        /* Subtle grid background for data slides */
        .bg-grid::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;

            background-image:

            background-size: clamp(35px, 5vw, 55px) clamp(35px, 5vw, 55px);
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           PROGRESS BAR
           =========================================== */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0; left: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-teal), var(--accent-blue));
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(0, 201, 167, 0.5);
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
            z-index: 1000;
            width: 0%;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           NAV DOTS (right side)
           =========================================== */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.25rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(5px, 1vh, 9px);
            z-index: 1000;
        }
        .nav-dot {
            width: clamp(5px, 0.7vw, 7px);
            height: clamp(5px, 0.7vw, 7px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--text-muted);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }
        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent-teal);
            box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--accent-teal);
            transform: scale(1.4);

        .nav-dot:hover { background: var(--accent-blue); }

        /* ===========================================

        .slide-num {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);

            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--mono-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);

        .source-note {

        .reveal {

            transition: opacity var(--dur) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--dur) var(--ease-out-expo);

        .slide.visible .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }

        .reveal-left {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(-28px);
            transition: opacity var(--dur) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--dur) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-left { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }

        .reveal-right {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(28px);
            transition: opacity var(--dur) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--dur) var(--ease-out-expo);

        .slide.visible .reveal-right { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }

         JAVASCRIPT — SlidePresentation Controller

    <script>
        /* === SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER === */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides      = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
                this.total       = this.slides.length;
                this.currentIdx  = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;

                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.navDotsEl   = document.getElementById('navDots');

                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupWheelNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();

                /* Trigger first slide immediately */
                this.slides[0].classList.add('visible');
                this.updateProgress(0);
            }

            /* --- IntersectionObserver: add .visible when slide enters viewport --- */
            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.currentIdx = idx;
                                this.updateProgress(idx);
                                this.updateNavDots(idx);
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
            }

            /* --- Navigation dots --- */
            setupNavDots() {
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className  = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go to slide ' + (i + 1));
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
                    this.navDotsEl.appendChild(dot);
                });
            }

            updateNavDots(idx) {
                const dots = this.navDotsEl.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
                dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === idx));
            }

            /* --- Progress bar --- */
            updateProgress(idx) {
                const pct = this.total <= 1 ? 100 : (idx / (this.total - 1)) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            /* --- Go to specific slide --- */
            goTo(idx) {
                if (idx < 0 || idx >= this.total) return;
                this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }

            /* --- Keyboard navigation (arrows, space, page up/down) --- */
            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    switch (e.key) {
                        case 'ArrowDown':
                        case 'ArrowRight':
                        case ' ':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goTo(this.currentIdx + 1);
                            break;
                        case 'ArrowUp':
                        case 'ArrowLeft':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goTo(this.currentIdx - 1);
                            break;
                        case 'PageDown':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goTo(this.currentIdx + 1);
                            break;
                        case 'PageUp':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goTo(this.currentIdx - 1);
                            break;
                        case 'Home':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goTo(0);
                            break;
                        case 'End':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goTo(this.total - 1);
                            break;
                    }
                });
            }

            /* --- Mouse wheel navigation (debounced) --- */
            setupWheelNav() {
                let wheelTimer = null;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    if (wheelTimer) return;
                    wheelTimer = setTimeout(() => { wheelTimer = null; }, 800);
                    if (e.deltaY > 0) this.goTo(this.currentIdx + 1);
                    else              this.goTo(this.currentIdx - 1);
                }, { passive: false });
            }

            /* --- Touch/swipe navigation --- */
            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = null;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                }, { passive: true });

                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    if (touchStartY === null) return;
                    const delta = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(delta) > 50) {
                        if (delta > 0) this.goTo(this.currentIdx + 1);
                        else           this.goTo(this.currentIdx - 1);
                    }
                    touchStartY = null;
                }, { passive: true });
            }
        }

        /* Initialise on DOM ready */
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => new SlidePresentation());
    </script>
</body>
</html>

            height: 100dvh;
            overflow: hidden;
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
        }

        /* Content container */
        .slide-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            max-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }

        .card, .container, .content-box {
            max-width: min(90vw, 1000px);
            max-height: min(80vh, 700px);
        }

        .feature-list, .bullet-list { gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 1rem); }
        .feature-list li, .bullet-list li { font-size: var(--body-size); line-height: 1.4; }

        .grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 250px), 1fr));
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }

        img, .image-container {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: min(50vh, 400px);
            object-fit: contain;
        }

        /* Short viewports */
        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap:   clamp(0.35rem, 1.2vw, 0.9rem);
                --title-size:    clamp(1.2rem, 4.5vw, 2.5rem);
                --h2-size:       clamp(1rem, 2.8vw, 1.75rem);
            }
        }
        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap:   clamp(0.25rem, 1vw, 0.6rem);
                --title-size:    clamp(1rem, 4vw, 1.8rem);
                --body-size:     clamp(0.65rem, 1.1vw, 0.9rem);
            }
            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative { display: none; }
        }
        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size:    clamp(0.95rem, 3.5vw, 1.4rem);
                --h2-size:       clamp(0.85rem, 2.5vw, 1.2rem);
                --body-size:     clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            }
        }
        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root { --title-size: clamp(1.2rem, 7vw, 2.5rem); }
            .grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }
        /* ===========================================
           END VIEWPORT-BASE.CSS
           =========================================== */

        /* ===========================================
           GLOBAL THEME STYLES
           =========================================== */
        body {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        /* Subtle grid background for data slides */
        .bg-grid::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(79, 172, 254, 0.035) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(79, 172, 254, 0.035) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: clamp(35px, 5vw, 55px) clamp(35px, 5vw, 55px);
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           PROGRESS BAR
           =========================================== */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0; left: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-teal), var(--accent-blue));
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(0, 201, 167, 0.5);
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
            z-index: 1000;
            width: 0%;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           NAV DOTS (right side)
           =========================================== */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.25rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(5px, 1vh, 9px);
            z-index: 1000;
        }
        .nav-dot {
            width: clamp(5px, 0.7vw, 7px);
            height: clamp(5px, 0.7vw, 7px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--text-muted);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }
        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent-teal);
            box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--accent-teal);
            transform: scale(1.4);
        }
        .nav-dot:hover { background: var(--accent-blue); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE NUMBER
           =========================================== */
        .slide-num {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
            right: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--mono-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            z-index: 10;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SOURCE FOOTNOTE
           =========================================== */
        .source-note {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
            left: var(--slide-padding);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.52rem, 0.75vw, 0.65rem);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            z-index: 10;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           REVEAL ANIMATIONS — triggered by .visible class
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(18px);
            transition: opacity var(--dur) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--dur) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }

        .reveal-left {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(-28px);
            transition: opacity var(--dur) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--dur) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-left { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }

        .reveal-right {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(28px);
            transition: opacity var(--dur) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--dur) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-right { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }

        .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.92);
            transition: opacity 0.65s var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform 0.65s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-scale { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }

        /* Stagger delays */
        .d1 { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .d2 { transition-delay: 0.15s; }
        .d3 { transition-delay: 0.25s; }
        .d4 { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
        .d5 { transition-delay: 0.45s; }
        .d6 { transition-delay: 0.55s; }
        .d7 { transition-delay: 0.65s; }

        /* ===========================================
           SHARED COMPONENT: SLIDE HEADER
           =========================================== */
        .slide-tag {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.4em;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--mono-size);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            letter-spacing: 0.16em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            background: rgba(0, 201, 167, 0.07);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 201, 167, 0.2);
            padding: 0.22em 0.65em;
            border-radius: 3px;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.4rem, 1.2vh, 0.9rem);
        }

        .slide-heading {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.15;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.8vh, 1.2rem);
        }
        .slide-heading em {
            font-style: normal;
            color: var(--accent-teal);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           CHART COMPONENTS
           =========================================== */
        .chart-wrap {
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }
        .chart-wrap svg {
            width: 100%;
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
            max-height: min(46vh, 340px);
            overflow: visible;
        }

        .chart-legend {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            margin-top: clamp(0.25rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem);
        }
        .legend-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.45em;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--mono-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }
        .legend-swatch {
            width: 18px;
            height: 3px;
            border-radius: 2px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 1: TITLE
           =========================================== */
        #s1 {
            justify-content: center;
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 85% 15%, rgba(79,172,254,0.07) 0%, transparent 55%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 15% 85%, rgba(0,201,167,0.07) 0%, transparent 55%),
                var(--bg-primary);
        }
        #s1 .grid-decor {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(79,172,254,0.03) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(79,172,254,0.03) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 56px 56px;
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        #s1 .accent-line {
            position: absolute;
            left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0;
            width: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0%, var(--accent-teal) 30%, var(--accent-blue) 70%, transparent 100%);
            opacity: 0.6;
        }

        .title-inner {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            max-width: min(92vw, 960px);
        }

        .title-eyebrow {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--mono-size);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            letter-spacing: 0.22em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.6rem, 2vh, 1.25rem);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.6em;
        }
        .title-eyebrow::before {
            content: '';
            display: block;
            width: 2em;
            height: 1px;
            background: var(--accent-teal);
        }

        .title-main {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 5.5vw, 4.2rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1.08;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }
        .title-main .t-highlight {
            color: var(--accent-teal);
        }

        .title-sub {
            font-size: clamp(0.82rem, 1.7vw, 1.15rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.55;
            margin-bottom: clamp(1rem, 3.5vh, 2.2rem);
            max-width: 70ch;
        }

        .title-meta-row {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .meta-block { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.2em; }
        .meta-lbl {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.55rem, 0.8vw, 0.68rem);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.14em;
        }
        .meta-val {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.68rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }
        .meta-sep {
            width: 1px;
            height: 32px;
            background: var(--border);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           CONTENT SLIDE BASE
           =========================================== */
        .content-slide {
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4: REQUESTS & CONNECTIONS — split layout
           =========================================== */
        .split-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem);
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
            align-items: start;
        }
        @media (max-width: 680px) {
            .split-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }

        .stat-stack {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 0.9rem);
        }
        .stat-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.65rem, 1.8vw, 1.25rem);
        }
        .stat-num {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 4vw, 3rem);
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--accent-blue);
            line-height: 1;
        }
        .stat-lbl {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: 0.3em;
            line-height: 1.3;
        }
        .stat-delta {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--mono-size);
            color: var(--accent-amber);
            margin-top: 0.4em;
        }
        .stat-decline {
            color: var(--accent-teal);
        }

        .chart-col {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            min-height: 0;
        }
        .chart-col-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--mono-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: 0.4em;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5: HTTPS — large stat + chart
           =========================================== */
        .https-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.6fr;
            gap: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3rem);
            align-items: center;
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
        }
        @media (max-width: 680px) {
            .https-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }

        .mega-stat {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(3.5rem, 11vw, 7.5rem);
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            line-height: 1;
            text-shadow: 0 0 50px rgba(0,201,167,0.25);
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }
        .mega-unit {
            font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3rem);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            opacity: 0.7;
        }
        .mega-label {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: 0.5em;
            line-height: 1.4;
        }
        .https-badges {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.6em;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }
        .badge {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--mono-size);
            background: rgba(0,201,167,0.08);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0,201,167,0.2);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            padding: 0.25em 0.7em;
            border-radius: 3px;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 6: PROTOCOL ADOPTION
           =========================================== */
        .protocol-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
        }
        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            .protocol-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }

        .proto-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.4rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.35rem, 1vh, 0.65rem);
        }
        .proto-card.h3-card {
            border-color: rgba(245,166,35,0.28);
            background: rgba(245,166,35,0.04);
        }
        .proto-name {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--mono-size);
            letter-spacing: 0.14em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }
        .proto-pct {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.8rem);
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--accent-blue);
            line-height: 1;
        }
        .proto-card.h3-card .proto-pct { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .proto-detail {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.45;
        }
        .proto-bar-track {
            height: 3px;
            background: var(--bg-card-2);
            border-radius: 2px;
            overflow: hidden;
            margin-top: 0.2em;
        }
        .proto-bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 2px;
            background: var(--accent-blue);
            width: 0%;
            transition: width 1s var(--ease-out-expo) 0.4s;
        }
        .proto-card.h3-card .proto-bar-fill { background: var(--accent-amber); }
        .slide.visible .proto-bar-fill { width: var(--fill-w); }

        .proto-mini-chart {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.3em;
        }
        .proto-mini-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--mono-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        }

        .caveat-box {
            background: rgba(79,172,254,0.05);
            border: 1px solid rgba(79,172,254,0.15);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1.2vw, 0.75rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 1vh, 0.6rem);
        }
        .caveat-text {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-style: italic;
            line-height: 1.45;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 7: FONT-DISPLAY
           =========================================== */
        .font-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.6fr;
            gap: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
            align-items: start;
        }
        @media (max-width: 680px) {
            .font-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }

        .font-stat-col {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 0.9rem);
        }
        .font-stat-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.65rem, 1.8vw, 1.2rem);
        }
        .font-stat-val {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 3rem);
            font-weight: 500;
            line-height: 1;
        }
        .font-stat-val.desktop { color: var(--accent-blue); }
        .font-stat-val.mobile  { color: var(--accent-teal); }
        .font-stat-lbl {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: 0.3em;
        }
        .font-stat-delta {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--mono-size);
            color: var(--accent-amber);
            margin-top: 0.3em;
        }
        .foit-box {
            background: rgba(245,166,35,0.06);
            border: 1px solid rgba(245,166,35,0.18);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }
        .foit-tag {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--mono-size);
            color: var(--accent-amber);
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            margin-bottom: 0.35em;
        }
        .foit-desc {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 8: KEY TAKEAWAYS
           =========================================== */
        .takeaway-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.45rem, 1.2vw, 0.85rem);
            flex: 1;
            min-height: 0;
            align-content: start;
        }
        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            .takeaway-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }

        .tak-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.65rem, 1.5vw, 1.1rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.3em;
        }
        .tak-num {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--mono-size);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        }
        .tak-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.82rem, 1.4vw, 1.05rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.25;
        }
        .tak-body {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.45;
        }

        .cta-banner {
            grid-column: 1 / -1;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0,201,167,0.08), rgba(79,172,254,0.08));
            border: 1px solid rgba(0,201,167,0.28);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.65rem, 1.5vw, 1.1rem);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.25rem);
        }
        .cta-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 1.6rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .cta-text-wrap { flex: 1; }
        .cta-lbl {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--mono-size);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: 0.2em;
        }
        .cta-body {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <!-- Progress bar — width updated by JS -->
    <div class="progress-bar" id="progressBar"></div>

    <!-- Nav dots — generated by JS -->
    <nav class="nav-dots" id="navDots" aria-label="Slide navigation"></nav>

    <!-- ============================================================
         SLIDE 1 — TITLE
         ============================================================ -->
    <section class="slide" id="s1" aria-label="Title slide">
        <div class="grid-decor"></div>
        <div class="accent-line"></div>

        <div class="title-inner">
            <div class="title-eyebrow reveal d1">HTTP Archive · State of the Web</div>

            <h1 class="title-main reveal d2">
                State of the Web<br>

    <script>
        /* === SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER === */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides      = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
                this.total       = this.slides.length;
                this.currentIdx  = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;

                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.navDotsEl   = document.getElementById('navDots');

                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupWheelNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();

                /* Trigger first slide immediately */
                this.slides[0].classList.add('visible');
                this.updateProgress(0);
            }

            /* --- IntersectionObserver: add .visible when slide enters viewport --- */
            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.currentIdx = idx;
                                this.updateProgress(idx);
                                this.updateNavDots(idx);
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
            }

            /* --- Navigation dots --- */
            setupNavDots() {
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className  = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go to slide ' + (i + 1));
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goTo(i));
                    this.navDotsEl.appendChild(dot);
                });
            }

            updateNavDots(idx) {
                const dots = this.navDotsEl.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
                dots.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === idx));
            }

            /* --- Progress bar --- */
            updateProgress(idx) {
                const pct = this.total <= 1 ? 100 : (idx / (this.total - 1)) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            /* --- Go to specific slide --- */
            goTo(idx) {
                if (idx < 0 || idx >= this.total) return;
                this.slides[idx].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }

            /* --- Keyboard navigation (arrows, space, page up/down) --- */
            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    switch (e.key) {
                        case 'ArrowDown':
                        case 'ArrowRight':
                        case ' ':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goTo(this.currentIdx + 1);
                            break;
                        case 'ArrowUp':
                        case 'ArrowLeft':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goTo(this.currentIdx - 1);
                            break;
                        case 'PageDown':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goTo(this.currentIdx + 1);
                            break;
                        case 'PageUp':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goTo(this.currentIdx - 1);
                            break;
                        case 'Home':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goTo(0);
                            break;
                        case 'End':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goTo(this.total - 1);
                            break;
                    }
                });
            }

            /* --- Mouse wheel navigation (debounced) --- */
            setupWheelNav() {
                let wheelTimer = null;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    if (wheelTimer) return;
                    wheelTimer = setTimeout(() => { wheelTimer = null; }, 800);
                    if (e.deltaY > 0) this.goTo(this.currentIdx + 1);
                    else              this.goTo(this.currentIdx - 1);
                }, { passive: false });
            }

            /* --- Touch/swipe navigation --- */
            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = null;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                }, { passive: true });

                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    if (touchStartY === null) return;
                    const delta = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(delta) > 50) {
                        if (delta > 0) this.goTo(this.currentIdx + 1);
                        else           this.goTo(this.currentIdx - 1);
                    }
                    touchStartY = null;
                }, { passive: true });
            }
        }

        /* Initialise on DOM ready */
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => new SlidePresentation());
    </script>

53	    // Fallback: treat the whole page as 1 slide
54	    if (slideCount === 0) slideCount = 1;
55	
56	    // Reasonable upper bound to prevent infinite loops
57	    if (slideCount > 100) slideCount = 100;
58	
59	    // --- Capture slide 1 (already visible on load) ---
60	    // Wait for entrance animations to settle
61	    await page.waitForTimeout(500);
62	    await page.screenshot({{ path: `{out_dir}/slide_001.png` }});
63	
64	    // --- Navigate through remaining slides via ArrowRight ---
65	    // We track visual changes to detect when navigation has no more effect
66	    // (i.e. we've passed the last slide).
67	    let prevPath = `{out_dir}/slide_001.png`;
68	    let captured = 1;
69	
70	    for (let i = 2; i <= slideCount; i++) {{
71	        await page.keyboard.press('ArrowRight');
72	        // Wait for transition animation to complete
73	        await page.waitForTimeout(600);
74	
75	        const idx = String(i).padStart(3, '0');
76	        const path = `{out_dir}/slide_${{idx}}.png`;
77	        await page.screenshot({{ path }});

87	def _deduplicate_slides(image_dir: Path) -> list[Path]:
88	    """Remove trailing duplicate screenshots (navigation past last slide).
89	
90	    Some presentations keep showing the last slide when you press ArrowRight
91	    beyond the end.  We detect this by comparing file sizes + pixel samples.
92	    """
93	    pngs = sorted(image_dir.glob("slide_*.png"))
94	    if len(pngs) <= 1:
95	        return pngs
96	
97	    unique: list[Path] = [pngs[0]]
98	    prev_img = Image.open(pngs[0])
99	
100	    for png in pngs[1:]:
101	        curr_img = Image.open(png)
102	        # Quick check: compare a grid of sample pixels
103	        is_dup = True
104	        for x_frac in (0.25, 0.5, 0.75):
105	            for y_frac in (0.25, 0.5, 0.75):
106	                px = int(curr_img.width * x_frac)
107	                py = int(curr_img.height * y_frac)
108	                if curr_img.getpixel((px, py)) != prev_img.getpixel((px, py)):
109	                    is_dup = False
110	                    break
111	            if not is_dup:
112	                break
113	
114	        if not is_dup:
115	            unique.append(png)
116	            prev_img = curr_img
117	        else:
118	            # Once we hit a duplicate, stop — remaining are likely all dupes
119	            break
120	
121	    return unique

124	def _start_http_server(directory: Path, port: int = 0):
125	    """Start a background HTTP server serving *directory*. Returns (server, port)."""
126	    handler = http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler
127	    server = http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", port), lambda *a, **kw: handler(*a, directory=str(directory), **kw))
128	    actual_port = server.server_address[1]
129	    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
130	    thread.start()
131	    return server, actual_port

134	def screenshot_slides(html_path: Path, out_dir: Path, width: int, height: int) -> list[Path]:
135	    """Run Playwright to capture per-slide PNGs. Returns deduplicated list."""
136	    # Serve via HTTP so Google Fonts and relative assets load correctly
137	    serve_dir = html_path.resolve().parent
138	    server, port = _start_http_server(serve_dir)
139	    url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/{html_path.resolve().name}"
140	
141	    try:
142	        script = _make_screenshot_script(url, str(out_dir), width, height)
143	        script_file = out_dir / "_capture.cjs"
144	        script_file.write_text(script)
145	
146	        env = os.environ.copy()
147	        env.setdefault("NODE_PATH", "/usr/local/lib/node_modules:/app/node_modules")
148	        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH", "/ms-playwright")
149	        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD", "1")
150	        result = subprocess.run(
151	            ["node", str(script_file)],
152	            capture_output=True,
153	            text=True,
154	            timeout=180,
155	            env=env,
156	        )
157	        if result.returncode != 0:
158	            print(f"Playwright stderr:\n{result.stderr}", file=sys.stderr)
159	            raise RuntimeError(f"Screenshot script failed (exit {result.returncode})")
160	    finally:
161	        server.shutdown()
162	
163	    pngs = _deduplicate_slides(out_dir)
164	    if not pngs:
165	        raise RuntimeError("No slide screenshots produced")
166	    return pngs

169	def assemble_pptx(slide_images: list[Path], output_path: Path) -> None:
170	    """Pack slide images into a standard 16:9 PPTX."""
171	    prs = Presentation()
172	    # Standard 16:9 dimensions
173	    prs.slide_width = Emu(12192000)   # 13.333 inches
174	    prs.slide_height = Emu(6858000)   # 7.5 inches
175	
176	    blank_layout = prs.slide_layouts[6]  # blank layout
177	
178	    for img_path in slide_images:
179	        slide = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
180	        slide.shapes.add_picture(
181	            str(img_path),
182	            left=Emu(0),
183	            top=Emu(0),
184	            width=prs.slide_width,
185	            height=prs.slide_height,
186	        )
187	
188	    prs.save(str(output_path))

192	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Convert HTML presentation to PPTX via screenshots")
193	    parser.add_argument("input_html", help="Path to the single-file HTML presentation")
194	    parser.add_argument("output_pptx", help="Output PPTX path")
195	    parser.add_argument("--width", type=int, default=1920, help="Viewport width (default 1920)")

steps.reasoning_content:
The script uses ArrowRight key press to navigate between slides and then waits 600ms. However, there's a deduplication step that removes slides that look the same. The issue might be:

1. The wheel navigation / keyboard navigation creates smooth scrolling, but the screenshot might be taken before the transition finishes, so multiple slides look the same (scrolled halfway).
2. Or the slides are being navigated correctly but the images of the same-looking background are being deduplicated.

Since the script detected that `.slide` returns more than 0 results (since there are 8 `.slide` elements), it should be trying to navigate 8 slides. 

The deduplication logic stops as soon as it finds a consecutive duplicate, so if slide 3 looks similar to slide 2 due to the dark background and scroll position, it would halt the collection process entirely. That's probably why only 2 unique slides made it through.

The real problem is likely the smooth scrolling behavior—when ArrowRight triggers `scrollIntoView({behavior: 'smooth'})`, the screenshot gets taken just 600ms later, which isn't enough time for all 8 slides to fully load and scroll into view. I need to either switch to instant scrolling in the presentation or increase the wait time before capturing.

Looking at the deduplication logic more carefully, it samples pixels at a 3x3 grid across each slide. If all slides have the same dark background with a grid pattern, those sampled points might look identical, especially if a slide is caught mid-scroll and only showing the dark background rather than its actual content.

The real culprits are likely the 800ms debounce on wheel navigation blocking keyboard input, and the 600ms wait being insufficient for smooth scrolling to complete before taking screenshots. I'll switch the `scrollIntoView` call to use instant behavior instead of smooth, which will snap slides into place immediately for cleaner captures, and remove the wheel navigation debounce conflict.
